title: TLS hostname verifier replaced (java)
description: java code installs its own hostname verifier (connection.setHostnameVerifier). When that verifier returns true for every host, the certificate still validates the chain but no longer validates the name, so any certificate for any domain satisfies the connection. This lexical rule flags the replacement; the reviewer confirms a real name check remains.
remediation: Remove the custom verifier and rely on the platform check, or implement one that compares the peer host with the platform verifier, unchanged.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: cannot tell a permissive verifier from a strict custom one.
